entities.summary: Brian Christopher Goodwin is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals, Kansas City Royals, Los Angeles Angels, Cincinnati Reds, and Chicago White Sox. He has also played in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Wei Chuan Dragons. Before his professional career, Goodwin played college baseball for the North Carolina Tar Heels.
